name: Waldimbiss
kurzbeschreibung: Forest snack bar at the Walderlebniszentrum Ziegelwies: hearty snacks, coffee and cake at the foot of the mountain forest near the Tyrolean border.
beschreibung:
The Waldimbiss (forest snack bar) belongs to the Walderlebniszentrum Füssen-Ziegelwies and is located near the border to Tyrol in the Außerfern region. The kiosk sits at the foot of the mountain forest, directly opposite the exhibition building.

The menu offers hearty snacks after hikes, coffee and cake, cold drinks and ice cream. Seating is available outdoors under a canopy or in the wooden pavilion for about 60 people. The Waldimbiss is thus part of an excursion area with a treetop path, mountain forest trail and riparian forest trail. Opening hours follow the Walderlebniszentrum season: daily from March to November, in winter on request. A parking lot on the Tyrolean side and a bus stop are just a few meters away.
